verdict.rationale: The OCR model page lists a Batching endpoint (/v1/batch), and a community tester mentions batched pricing, so bulk submission of many documents appears supported. The evidence is a single thin line with no workflow documentation, and one hands-on user had to manually split a 900-page job into chunks after a timeout. Missing for 10: documented batch job workflow (submission, status, result retrieval), limits and scale guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation that batch processing works at volume.
